scope: Weekly raid completion and periodic recovery request one shared worker plus one pending bit, not a worker per earned completion.
Recovery discovers live character completion outboxes, including disconnected players whose completions are not yet in Mongo, before recovering saved offline outboxes and recorded entitlements.

Existing complete-character journal, trusted original kill week, account-work serialization, grant receipt and entitlement acknowledgement remain authoritative. Admission rejection and failed preparation do not consume completions.
Preparation captures one initial canonical entity copy and handles entity expiry after entitlement creation without dereferencing a missing entity or writing a stale live snapshot.
Immediate private completion copy says processing, not secured before persistence. Normal inventory/endgame reward feedback follows the existing confirmed delivery path.

evidence: Eight producers issue512 requests while a pass is held and combat/world/account locks are owned. No parallel consumer; exactly one follow-up pass.

A failed simulated database commit leaves the actual character journal with the original completion and ungranted Gold. A later request grants once and saves the receipt; no tight automatic retry loop.
Sealed worker admission leaves both pending coordination state and the live completion intact without a fake save or acknowledgement.
An unsaved disconnected recipient is discovered and paid once with the original Sunday kill week, not the recovery week. Subsequent recovery does not pay again.
Expiry during entitlement preparation returns a retryable failure while the recorded entitlement is delivered offline. Later recovery clears the remaining completion without a second grant.
Game discovery includes both Sunday/Monday completions for a disconnected player, excludes nonplayers and returns detached identity/time values.
Existing weekly journal/restart/acknowledgement/failure/recipient isolation and worker/connection/save/PvP regressions pass. git diff --check passes.

limits: In-process race checks use actual local save journals and a simulated database committer/store; this is not a latest-binary connected raid clear, Mongo failover, public deployment or capacity claim.
The combat completion begins in memory until the existing journal write succeeds. This change does not claim crash durability before that write or invent an earlier secured acknowledgement.
This bounds weekly recovery workers, not total journal/outbox size, guild leaderboard completion workers or the broader resource/security milestone.
Earlier connected binaries retain their recorded source scopes. Final release integration and ordered publication after account recovery remain required. Accepted production remains Alpha1.70.0.
